title: Group Portrait of Family Outdoors, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white 1950s snapshot depicting a group of five adults—four women and one man—posing closely together in an outdoor yard setting with trees in the background. The man in the center wears a suit jacket with a patterned bow tie, while the women are dressed in mid-century patterned dresses and summer attire typical of postwar American domestic gatherings. The photograph features deckled edges and album mounting perforations on the left margin.
